name: Anhui Coreach Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Anhui Coreach Technology Co.,Ltd designs, develops, produces, and sells display materials, modules, and terminals. It manufactures direct-lit backlight module optoelectronic, edge-lit backlight module optoelectronic, quantum dot displays optoelectronic, and mini-LED backlight display optoelectronic systems. It also provides small-pitch display modules, all-in-one machines, automotive display terminals, commercial displays, and digital TVs based on traditional TFT-LCD technology. In addition, it offers healthy intelligent light source systems. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Hefei, China.
